CustomField.description: The Id of the org AI Assist was switched on in, written by AI Assist. When it does not match the org the code is running in, AI Assist treats itself as switched off: a sandbox created or refreshed from production copies this row, and must not start calling the AI provider with production's configuration until an administrator activates it there. Retention still runs. Blank means not yet recorded; it is filled in the first time AI Assist runs while switched on.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by AI Assist. If this is another org's Id (a sandbox copied from production), AI Assist stays off until it is activated here.
CustomField.label: Activated Org Id
